projects.title: FilterHacker (CruzHacks 2018)
projects.description: Worked with teammate to create FilterHacker, an experimental photo-sharing social network where users code their own filters, aimed at making programming accessible to young people. I wrote all of the backend and significant partsof the frontend (Go, MongoDB, HTML/CSS).

projects.title: Traffic Simulation
projects.description:
Worked with a team of one programmer and two humanities students to define a computational problem to solve. As the lead developer, I wrote:
• A library to manage path finding and simulating dynamic, time-based high-volume network flow problems
• A client program implementing details of foot, car, and bus travel
• A web portal for the group members to use
